nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Documentation for the Waggle Companion Chrome MV3 extension, covering its v0.1.0 feature set (popup, context menu, sidecar reuse), developer install steps, sidecar API contract, verification checklist, and post-MVP roadmap.

nodes.name: manifest.json
nodes.summary: Chrome Extension Manifest V3 descriptor for Waggle Companion, declaring activeTab/storage/contextMenus permissions, localhost:3333 host permissions, popup.html as the action target, background service worker, and a content script injected at document_idle on all URLs.
nodes.languageNotes: MV3 manifest uses a service_worker background (not persistent background pages); host_permissions are scoped to localhost:3333 only, enforcing the localhost-only security posture described in the README.

nodes.name: popup.html
nodes.summary: Browser extension popup UI shell using inline dark Hive design system tokens (honey #e5a000, hive-950 #08090c), rendering connection status, active workspace name, save-selection/save-page/open-waggle action buttons, and a toast notification area; loads popup.js for dynamic behavior.
